title: Literature Explorer
role: Extend a topic through literature search, bibliography growth, and evidence-trail building.
description: A research-support tool for finding related literature, building reading lists, and expanding bibliographies with CiteGeist support.

implementation.public_role: A metadata-driven research support surface for topic expansion and bibliography discovery.

api.notes: Public evo-edu surface remains a guided wrapper around the existing CiteGeist codebase and API workflow.

tests.notes: The underlying CiteGeist codebase already has its own test suite.
